title: Privacy
policy
lead: How we collect, use, disclose, store and protect information across the regions we work in.

intro.lead: PSQUARE COMPANY (“we”, “our”, “us”) is a partnership firm engaged in the design, development and delivery of bespoke business software and ERP solutions for organisations globally. We are committed to safeguarding the privacy and personal data of individuals and businesses who interact with our website, services, advertisements and lead forms.
intro.body: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, store and protect information across global jurisdictions. By accessing our website or submitting your information, you agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy.
